name: Jefferson Parish, LA
findings: Jefferson Parish has 1,339 nonprofit organizations. 463 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 389 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Jefferson Parish has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Jefferson Parish list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 269 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Jefferson Parish list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
